mapper.select: SELECT id_cita as idCita, DATE_FORMAT(fecha_cita, '%Y-%m-%d') as fechaCita, hora_cita as horaCita, id_paciente as idPaciente, id_medico as idMedico, observaciones, estatus, motivo_cancelacion as motivoCancelacion, DATE_FORMAT(fecha_creacion, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as fechaCreacion FROM cita WHERE id_paciente = #{idPaciente} AND fecha_cita = #{fechaCita}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cita (fecha_cita, hora_cita, id_paciente, id_medico, observaciones, estatus) VALUES (#{fechaCita}, #{horaCita}, #{idPaciente}, #{idMedico}, #{observaciones}, 'Confirmada')
mapper.select: SELECT id_cita as idCita, DATE_FORMAT(fecha_cita, '%Y-%m-%d') as fechaCita, hora_cita as horaCita, id_paciente as idPaciente, id_medico as idMedico, observaciones, estatus, motivo_cancelacion as motivoCancelacion, DATE_FORMAT(fecha_creacion, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as fechaCreacion FROM cita WHERE id_cita = #{idCita}

mapper.select: SELECT c.id_cita as idCita, DATE_FORMAT(c.fecha_cita, '%d/%m/%Y') as fechaCita, c.hora_cita as horaCita, c.id_paciente as idPaciente, c.id_medico as idMedico, c.estatus as estatus, c.motivo_cancelacion as motivoCancelacion, DATE_FORMAT(c.fecha_creacion, '%d/%m/%Y %H:%i') as fechaCreacion, m.nombre as medicoNombre, m.primer_apellido as medicoPrimerApellido, m.segundo_apellido as medicoSegundoApellido FROM cita c INNER JOIN medico m ON c.id_medico = m.id_medico WHERE c.id_paciente = #{idPaciente} ORDER BY c.fecha_cita DESC, c.hora_cita DESC
